title: DISTINCT of a table does not return the blank row

source.quote: DISTINCT returns the distinct rows in the table
source.supports: DISTINCT of a table returns its distinct rows; the page's example counts none for the blank row

source.quote: the VALUES function treats the blank row as a regular row, returning it. On the other hand, DISTINCT never returns the blank row
source.supports: DISTINCT never returns the blank row

derivation: Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so the relationship is invalid and Product gets a blank row. DISTINCT ( Product ) returns only the 3 stored rows, which are all different.
